channel.title: Optimization Reasoning :: CS Two Year Refactor
channel.description: Working draft for faculty review. A lens is a standing question or practice applied across the two-year core, scope growing with capability — not a topic taught in one place. One of three lenses (with eight spirals and one bounded practice — twelve threads total, plus two cross-cutting norms). In one line: “Best under constraints,” named wherever it already arises, so students reach the AI specialization already thinking in optimization terms.
